AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 15, 2025
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Geetanjali Reuben, Chair  Ryan Gales, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO LGBARPT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54944  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on March 20, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54945  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight, featuring Shannon Bratton with The MODERN.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54946  Recommendation to consider the content of the Airport Advisory Commission 2024
  Annual Report and take action to refer it to the City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55113  Recommendation to review and update Commissioner assignments to City
  Councilmembers for the purpose of providing briefings to Councilmembers
  regarding activities of the Airport Advisory Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-54947  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality, and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

to the meeting.
